evidence.detail: parse_and_validate_decklist(check_legality=False) skips ALL legality checks, including card-level legality
check_legality gate surrounds check_deck_legality(), which checks both deck size and card legality together
legal_formats() checks deck size (<60 cards) before checking card legality, so passing check_legality=True would immediately fail on an incomplete manabase submission

triage.fix_sketch: In magic/legality.py add an optional skip_size_checks=False param to legal_formats(); when True, skip the <60-card and >15-sideboard checks. In decksite/form.py add a check_only_card_legality() method that calls legal_formats with skip_size_checks=True. In decksite/manabase.py:ManabaseForm.do_validation, call check_only_card_legality() instead of leaving check_legality=False.
triage.notes: The fix must not change how league and tournament submission behave; those call parse_and_validate_decklist() with the default check_legality=True and must remain unaffected.
